mapper.select: SELECT id, puzzle, solution, level, description, create_time, update_time FROM sudoku_puzzles WHERE level = #{level} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sudoku_puzzles (puzzle, solution, level, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{puzzle}, #{solution}, #{level}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sudoku_puzzles SET puzzle = #{puzzle}, solution = #{solution}, level = #{level}, description = #{description}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
